title: Influence bound within the threshold interval
statement: Let $0<\varepsilon<\tfrac12$, and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Let $\eta>0$, and suppose $\eta$ times the bias variance scale at the critical probability of $f$ is at most the width of its threshold interval at error level $\varepsilon$. Then there is a bias parameter $p$ strictly between the two threshold parameters for which the biased minus-probability lies strictly between $\varepsilon$ and $1-\varepsilon$, and the total influence under the corresponding biased product distribution is at most $(1-2\varepsilon)(4+1/\eta)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\eta$ times the bias variance scale at the critical probability is at most the threshold interval width
